# Purpose and safe-output policy

This document reconstructs the annotation-validation plots and tables from source objects and prediction files. Input files are read-only. Analysis outputs go to a unique `reproducibility_test_*` directory under `PREDICT/ligand_receptor/annotation_validation_BUB/reproducibility_runs/`; accepted deliverables are not overwritten. The knitted HTML report itself is placed by RStudio/R Markdown according to its normal output settings. The large filtered all-cell Seurat RDS export is disabled by default and can be enabled after the test run is reviewed.

# 2. Shared plotting and analysis helpers

## 2.1 Lineage preparation and UMAPs

```{r helper-lineage-umap}
# Apply updated annotations by barcode, preserve known original doublets,
# optionally designate additional doublet clusters, and return both the
# annotated object and the object used for plotting. Unknown non-doublet
# labels fail loudly rather than being silently dropped or guessed.
prepare_lineage <- function(object_path, main_label, doublet_clusters = NULL,
                            label_renames = character(0),
                            original_label_col = "annotations_fine") {
  object <- readRDS(object_path)
  cell_ids <- colnames(object)

  meta <- updated_annotations %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$annotations_main == main_label,
      .data$barcode %in% cell_ids
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(barcode, annotations_main, annotations_fine)

  if (nrow(meta) == 0) {
    stop("No updated metadata rows matched ", object_path,
         " using annotations_main = '", main_label, "'.")
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(meta$barcode)) {
    stop("Duplicate barcode records remain after filtering metadata for '", main_label, "'.")
  }

  idx <- match(cell_ids, meta$barcode)
  labels <- as.character(meta$annotations_fine[idx])
  metadata_matched <- !is.na(idx)

  # Apply only explicit, already discussed display-name updates.
  if (length(label_renames) > 0) {
    for (old_label in names(label_renames)) {
      labels[!is.na(labels) & labels == old_label] <- unname(label_renames[[old_label]])
    }
  }

  doublet_mask <- rep(FALSE, length(cell_ids))
  meta_data <- object[[]]
  if (original_label_col %in% colnames(meta_data)) {
    doublet_mask <- doublet_mask |
      (!is.na(meta_data[[original_label_col]]) & as.character(meta_data[[original_label_col]]) == "Doublets")
  }

  if (!is.null(doublet_clusters)) {
    cluster_column <- doublet_clusters$column
    if (!cluster_column %in% colnames(meta_data)) {
      stop("Cluster column '", cluster_column, "' not found in ", object_path)
    }
    doublet_mask <- doublet_mask |
      (as.character(meta_data[[cluster_column]]) %in% as.character(doublet_clusters$clusters))
  }
  labels[doublet_mask] <- "Doublets"

  missing_labels <- is.na(labels) | !nzchar(labels)
  if (any(missing_labels)) {
    example_ids <- head(cell_ids[missing_labels], 10)
    stop(sum(missing_labels), " cells in ", object_path,
         " had no updated annotation and were not identified as doublets. Examples: ",
         paste(example_ids, collapse = ", "))
  }

  object$annotations_plot <- labels
  keep_cells <- cell_ids[labels != "Doublets"]
  clean <- subset(object, cells = keep_cells)

  message(
    main_label, ": cells in object = ", length(cell_ids),
    "; matched updated metadata = ", sum(metadata_matched),
    "; doublets excluded = ", sum(labels == "Doublets"),
    "; cells retained = ", length(keep_cells)
  )

  # Return only the cleaned object and small diagnostics, not the full input
  # object or large metadata tables, to limit memory use across lineages.
  list(clean = clean, n_input = length(cell_ids),
       n_metadata_matched = sum(metadata_matched),
       n_doublets_excluded = sum(labels == "Doublets"),
       n_retained = length(keep_cells))
}

# Standard UMAP with optional L-shaped arrows located relative to the
# existing embedding limits. This never recomputes the embedding.

plot_lineage_umap <- function(
    object, order, title,
    config = plot_config,
    arrows = config$add_umap_arrows,
    embedding_aspect_ratio = 0.8,
        point_size = 1
) {
   observed <- unique(as.character(object$annotations_plot))
   unexpected <- setdiff(observed, order)
   if (length(unexpected) > 0) stop("Unexpected labels in ", title, ": ", paste(unexpected, collapse = ", "))
   absent <- setdiff(order, observed)
   if (length(absent) > 0) warning("No retained cells for expected labels in ", title, ": ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
   object$annotations_plot <- factor(as.character(object$annotations_plot), levels = order)
p <- DimPlot(
  object,
  reduction = config$umap_reduction,
  group.by = "annotations_plot",
  label = FALSE,
    pt.size = point_size,
  alpha = 1,
  shuffle = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  raster = TRUE,
  raster.dpi = c(900, 900)
) +
    scale_color_discrete(breaks = order, drop = FALSE) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        keyheight = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        keywidth = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
        override.aes = list(size = 2)
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        title, "\nn = ", format(ncol(object), big.mark = " ")
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      # Consistent publication typography
      text = element_text(family = config$plot_base_family),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 6,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        lineheight = 0.9
            ),

      # Compact legend, matching marker-panel spacing
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(1, "mm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(1, "mm"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      aspect.ratio = embedding_aspect_ratio 
      )
 
   if (isTRUE(arrows)) {
     emb <- Seurat::Embeddings(object, config$umap_reduction)
     x_range <- range(emb[, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
     y_range <- range(emb[, 2], na.rm = TRUE)
     x_span <- diff(x_range)
    y_span <- diff(y_range)
     x0 <- x_range[1] + config$arrow_origin_x_fraction * x_span
    y0 <- y_range[1] + config$arrow_origin_y_fraction * y_span
    dx <- config$arrow_fraction * x_span
   dy <- config$arrow_fraction * y_span
    p <- p +
       annotate("segment", x = x0, xend = x0 + dx, y = y0, yend = y0,
               arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(config$arrow_line_cm, "cm")),
               linewidth = config$arrow_linewidth) +
      annotate("segment", x = x0, xend = x0, y = y0, yend = y0 + dy,
              arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(config$arrow_line_cm, "cm")),
              linewidth = config$arrow_linewidth) +
     annotate("text", x = x0 + dx / 2, y = y0 - 0.025 * y_span,
             label = "UMAP 1", size = config$arrow_text_size) +
     annotate("text", x = x0 - 0.02 * x_span, y = y0 + dy / 2,
              label = "UMAP 2", angle = 90, size = config$arrow_text_size)
 }
 p
}

# For export, scale UMAP plot point sizes by number of cells to get consistent visual
get_umap_point_size <- function(
    n_cells,
    reference_n = umap_reference_n,
    reference_pt_size = 1,
    min_size = 1,
    max_size = 2.6
) {
  size <- reference_pt_size * (reference_n / n_cells)^0.35
  pmin(max_size, pmax(min_size, size))
}
```

## 2.2 Marker-gene dotplot helper

```{r helper-marker-dotplot}
# Standard marker dot plot. Marker-list names should match the displayed
# population labels in the order vector; missing assay genes are reported.
plot_lineage_markers <- function(
    object, order, marker_sets,
    config = plot_config,
    assay = config$marker_assay,
    extra_features = character(0),
    square_cells = TRUE
)  {
  observed <- unique(as.character(object$annotations_plot))
  unexpected <- setdiff(observed, order)
  if (length(unexpected) > 0) stop("Unexpected labels in marker plot: ", paste(unexpected, collapse = ", "))
  absent <- setdiff(order, observed)
  if (length(absent) > 0) warning("No retained cells for expected marker groups: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
  missing_sets <- setdiff(order, names(marker_sets))
  if (length(missing_sets) > 0) {
    stop("Marker sets are missing for: ", paste(missing_sets, collapse = ", "))
  }
  genes <- unique(c(
    unname(unlist(marker_sets[order], use.names = FALSE)),
    extra_features
  ))
  assay_genes <- rownames(object[[assay]])
  missing_genes <- setdiff(genes, assay_genes)
  if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
    warning("Markers absent from assay '", assay, "' and omitted: ",
            paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
  }
  genes <- intersect(genes, assay_genes)
  if (length(genes) == 0) stop("No requested marker genes were found in assay '", assay, "'.")

  object$annotations_plot <- factor(as.character(object$annotations_plot), levels = rev(order))
    p <- DotPlot(
    object = object,
    group.by = "annotations_plot",
    features = genes,
    assay = assay
  ) +
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = config$marker_colour_low,
      mid = config$marker_colour_mid,
      high = config$marker_colour_high,
      midpoint = config$marker_expression_midpoint
    ) +
    scale_size(
      range = config$marker_dot_range,
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = config$percent_breaks
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = NULL,
      colour = "Average Expression",
      size = "Percent Expressed"
    ) +
guides(
  size = guide_legend(
    order = 1,
    keyheight = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
    keywidth = grid::unit(3, "mm")
  ),
  colour = guide_colourbar(
    order = 2,
    barheight = grid::unit(12, "mm"),
    barwidth = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
    ticks = FALSE
  )
) +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    family = "Arial",
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = config$marker_axis_x_size
  ),
  axis.text.y = element_text(
    family = "Arial",
    size = config$marker_axis_y_size
  ),
  legend.text = element_text(
    family = "Arial",
    size = config$marker_legend_text_size
  ),
  legend.title = element_text(
    family = "Arial",
    size = config$marker_legend_title_size
  ),
    legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.5, "mm"),
  legend.key.height = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
  plot.title = element_text(
    size = config$marker_title_size,
    colour = config$plot_text_colour
  ),
  panel.border = element_rect(
    colour = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ),
  axis.line = element_blank(),
  panel.grid = element_blank()
)

  if (isTRUE(square_cells)) {
    p <- p + theme(
      aspect.ratio = length(order) / length(genes)
    )
  }

    # Record grid dimensions for export sizing
attr(p, "marker_export_counts") <- list(
  n_genes = length(genes),
  n_populations = length(order)
)

    
  p
}
```

## 2.3 Agreement analysis, plotting and calibration helpers

```{r helper-agreement-plot}
# ============================================================
# AGREEMENT PLOTS: SHARED STYLE, ADAPTIVE WIDTH, CONSISTENT ROWS
# ============================================================

agreement_export_config <- list(
  row_height_mm = 2.0,
  min_categories = 7,
  left_labels_mm = 36,
  right_legend_mm = 28,
  inter_panel_gap_mm = 4,
  outer_margin_mm = 4,
  top_allowance_mm = 8,
  bottom_label_allowance_mm = 55,
  initial_width_mm = 134,
  initial_height_mm = 75,
  max_iter = 15,
  tolerance_mm = 0.05
)

# Display-only aliases for long Celltypist and SCimilarity labels that won't fit plot.
# Original prediction names remain unchanged for all calculations.
prediction_display_aliases <- c(
  "CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human" =
    "CD16- CD56bright NK*",
  "naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell" =
    "Thymic-naive CD4+ ab T*",
  "naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell" =
    "Thymic-naive CD8+ ab T*",
  "effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell" =
    "Effector memory CD4+ ab T*",
  "activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell" =
    "Activated CD4+ ab T*",
  "CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T cell" =
    "CD8+ ab cytotoxic T*",
  "CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell" =
    "CD4+ ab T*",
  "group 3 innate lymphoid cell" =
    "ILC3*",
  "CD4-positive helper T cell" =
    "CD4+ helper T*",
  "CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell" =
    "CD4+ ab memory T*",
  "CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell" =
    "CD8+ ab memory T*",
  "CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell" =
    "CD8+ ab T*",
  
  #renames for other lineages
  "MMP9+ Inflammatory macrophage" = "MMP9+ Inflammatory MQ*",
  "endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel" =
  "lymphatic endothelial cell*"
)

# ---- Build one faceted agreement plot ----
make_agreement_plot <- function(
    object,
    manual_order,
    config = plot_config
) {
  comparison <- data.frame(
    barcode = colnames(object),
    manual = as.character(object$annotations_plot),
    celltypist = celltypist$predicted_labels[
      match(colnames(object), celltypist$bc)
    ],
    scimilarity = scimilarity$SC_predictions_unconstrained[
      match(colnames(object), scimilarity$SC_bc)
    ],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  agreement_long <- comparison %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(celltypist, scimilarity),
      names_to = "method",
      values_to = "prediction"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(prediction), !is.na(manual))

  if (nrow(agreement_long) == 0) {
    stop("No automated predictions matched the cells for this agreement plot.")
  }

  agreement_long$method <- factor(
    agreement_long$method,
    levels = c("celltypist", "scimilarity")
  )

  prediction_counts <- agreement_long %>%
    dplyr::count(method, prediction, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n), prediction, .by_group = TRUE)

  if (identical(config$agreement_selection, "cumulative")) {
    top_predictions <- prediction_counts %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        cumulative_fraction = cumsum(n) / sum(n)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        dplyr::lag(cumulative_fraction, default = 0) <
          config$agreement_coverage
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(method, prediction)

  } else if (identical(config$agreement_selection, "top_n")) {
    top_predictions <- prediction_counts %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = config$agreement_top_n) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(method, prediction)

  } else {
    stop("plot_config$agreement_selection must be 'cumulative' or 'top_n'.")
  }

  # Group predictions using original labels.
  agreement_grouped <- agreement_long %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::mutate(top_predictions, keep = TRUE),
      by = c("method", "prediction")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      prediction_group = ifelse(
        is.na(keep),
        config$other_label,
        prediction
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      method, manual, prediction_group,
      name = "n_cells"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method, manual) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      percentage = 100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # Display aliases affect only labels, never calculations.
  # Apply aliases to either method when an original label matches.
  agreement_grouped$prediction_display <-
    as.character(agreement_grouped$prediction_group)

  alias_idx <- match(
    agreement_grouped$prediction_display,
    names(prediction_display_aliases)
  )

  use_alias <- !is.na(alias_idx)

  agreement_grouped$prediction_display[use_alias] <-
    unname(prediction_display_aliases[alias_idx[use_alias]])

  # Order predictions by their original frequency within each method.
  method_orders <- agreement_grouped %>%
    dplyr::filter(prediction_group != config$other_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method, prediction_group, prediction_display) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total = sum(n_cells),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      method,
      dplyr::desc(total),
      prediction_group
    )

  display_levels <- unique(c(
    method_orders$prediction_display,
    config$other_label
  ))

  agreement_grouped$prediction_display <- factor(
    agreement_grouped$prediction_display,
    levels = display_levels
  )

  manual_levels <- rev(manual_order)

  agreement_grouped$manual <- factor(
    as.character(agreement_grouped$manual),
    levels = manual_levels
  )

  # Coverage remains based on original prediction strings.
  coverage <- agreement_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_predictions = dplyr::n(),
      retained_predictions = sum(
        prediction %in% top_predictions$prediction[
          top_predictions$method == dplyr::first(method)
        ]
      ),
      retained_percent =
        100 * retained_predictions / total_predictions,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    agreement_grouped,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = prediction_display,
      y = manual,
      size = percentage,
      colour = percentage
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(
      . ~ method,
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x",
      labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(c(
        celltypist = "CellTypist",
        scimilarity = "SCimilarity"
      ))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = config$agreement_colour_low,
      mid = config$agreement_colour_mid,
      high = config$agreement_colour_high,
      midpoint = config$agreement_colour_midpoint,
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = config$percent_breaks,
      name = "% of cells"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_size(
      range = config$agreement_dot_range,
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = config$percent_breaks,
      name = "% of cells"
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      size = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        keyheight = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        keywidth = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1)
      ),
      colour = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(
        order = 2,
        barheight = grid::unit(18, "mm"),
        barwidth = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        ticks = FALSE
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(
      base_size = 6,
      base_family = config$plot_base_family
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = config$plot_base_family,
        colour = config$plot_text_colour
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5,
        size = 6,
        colour = config$plot_text_colour
      ),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 6,
        colour = config$plot_text_colour
      ),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.25
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(1, "mm"),

      # Grey facet headers; normal-weight 6 pt text.
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 6,
        face = "bold",
        family = config$plot_base_family,
        colour = config$plot_text_colour
      ),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = NA
      ),

      # Transparent panel interiors with black borders.
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = NA
      ),
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.4
      ),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(
        colour = config$agreement_grid_colour,
        linewidth = config$agreement_grid_linewidth
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 6,
        family = config$plot_base_family,
        colour = config$plot_text_colour
      ),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 6,
        family = config$plot_base_family,
        colour = config$plot_text_colour
      ),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.5, "mm"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
      legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(1, "mm"),
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm")
    )

  method_counts <- agreement_grouped %>%
    dplyr::distinct(method, prediction_display) %>%
    dplyr::count(method, name = "n_categories")

  result <- list(
    plot = plot,
    coverage = coverage,
    n_manual_rows = length(manual_levels),
    method_counts = method_counts,
    grouped = agreement_grouped
  )

  if (isTRUE(config$keep_agreement_intermediates)) {
    result$comparison <- comparison
    result$long <- agreement_long
    result$top_predictions <- top_predictions
  }

  result
}





# ---- Measure rendered facet panels on an SVG device ----
measure_agreement_panels_mm <- function(plot, width_mm, height_mm) {
  tmp_svg <- tempfile(fileext = ".svg")

  svglite::svglite(
    file = tmp_svg,
    width = width_mm / 25.4,
    height = height_mm / 25.4
  )

  on.exit({
    try(grDevices::dev.off(), silent = TRUE)
    unlink(tmp_svg)
  }, add = TRUE)

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(ggplot2::ggplotGrob(plot))
  grid::grid.force()

  viewport_names <- unique(
    grid::grid.ls(
      viewports = TRUE,
      grobs = FALSE,
      print = FALSE
    )$name
  )

  panel_names <- grep(
    "^panel-[0-9]+-[0-9]+\\.",
    viewport_names,
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(panel_names) < 2) {
    stop(
      "Expected CellTypist and SCimilarity panel viewports; found ",
      length(panel_names), "."
    )
  }

  panel_dims <- lapply(panel_names, function(nm) {
    grid::seekViewport(nm)

    dims <- c(
      width_mm = grid::convertWidth(
        grid::unit(1, "npc"), "mm", valueOnly = TRUE
      ),
      height_mm = grid::convertHeight(
        grid::unit(1, "npc"), "mm", valueOnly = TRUE
      )
    )

    grid::upViewport(0)

    data.frame(
      viewport = nm,
      width_mm = unname(dims["width_mm"]),
      height_mm = unname(dims["height_mm"])
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, panel_dims)
}


# ---- Calibrate and export one agreement plot ----
calibrate_and_export_agreement <- function(
    plot,
    name,
    output_dir,
    config = agreement_export_config
) {
  dat <- plot$data

  method_counts <- dat %>%
    dplyr::distinct(method, prediction_display) %>%
    dplyr::count(method, name = "n_categories")

  if (!all(c("celltypist", "scimilarity") %in%
           as.character(method_counts$method))) {
    stop("Expected both methods in agreement plot: ", name)
  }

  min_categories <- min(method_counts$n_categories)

  # Keep the normal cell size if both facets have at least 7 categories.
  # Otherwise, expand the category slots in BOTH facets until the smaller
  # facet has a width equivalent to 7 square-cell slots.
  width_multiplier <- max(
    1,
    config$min_categories / min_categories
  )

  category_width_mm <- config$row_height_mm * width_multiplier

  # Target panel dimensions are based on the rendered category slots and rows.
  target_panel_width_mm <-
    sum(method_counts$n_categories) * category_width_mm

  n_manual <- length(unique(as.character(dat$manual)))
  target_panel_height_mm <- n_manual * config$row_height_mm

  width_mm <- target_panel_width_mm +
    config$left_labels_mm +
    config$right_legend_mm +
    config$inter_panel_gap_mm +
    config$outer_margin_mm

  height_mm <- target_panel_height_mm +
    config$top_allowance_mm +
    config$bottom_label_allowance_mm +
    config$outer_margin_mm

  converged <- FALSE

  for (i in seq_len(config$max_iter)) {
    measured <- measure_agreement_panels_mm(
      plot,
      width_mm,
      height_mm
    )

    actual_width_mm <- sum(measured$width_mm)
    actual_height_mm <- median(measured$height_mm)

    width_error <- target_panel_width_mm - actual_width_mm
    height_error <- target_panel_height_mm - actual_height_mm

    if (abs(width_error) <= config$tolerance_mm &&
        abs(height_error) <= config$tolerance_mm) {
      converged <- TRUE
      break
    }

    width_mm <- width_mm + width_error
    height_mm <- height_mm + height_error

    if (!is.finite(width_mm) || !is.finite(height_mm) ||
        width_mm <= 0 || height_mm <= 0) {
      stop("Invalid calibrated dimensions for ", name)
    }
  }

  measured <- measure_agreement_panels_mm(
    plot,
    width_mm,
    height_mm
  )

  actual_width_mm <- sum(measured$width_mm)
  actual_height_mm <- median(measured$height_mm)

  output_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(name, "_agreement.svg")
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = plot,
    width = width_mm,
    height = height_mm,
    units = "mm",
    device = svglite::svglite,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  if (!converged) {
    warning(
      "Geometry did not reach tolerance for ", name,
      ". Inspect the manifest and SVG."
    )
  }

  data.frame(
    lineage = name,
    n_celltypist_categories = method_counts$n_categories[
      method_counts$method == "celltypist"
    ],
    n_scimilarity_categories = method_counts$n_categories[
      method_counts$method == "scimilarity"
    ],
    n_manual_rows = n_manual,
    row_height_target_mm = config$row_height_mm,
    min_categories = config$min_categories,
    width_multiplier = width_multiplier,
    category_width_target_mm = category_width_mm,
    target_panel_width_mm = target_panel_width_mm,
    measured_panel_width_mm = actual_width_mm,
    target_panel_height_mm = target_panel_height_mm,
    measured_panel_height_mm = actual_height_mm,
    width_error_mm = actual_width_mm - target_panel_width_mm,
    height_error_mm = actual_height_mm - target_panel_height_mm,
    export_width_mm = width_mm,
    export_height_mm = height_mm,
    converged = converged,
    file = output_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

## 3.4 Epithelial cells & Enterocytes: subset, integrate and cluster

The epithelial and enterocyte populations are analysed jointly to represent enterocytes and other epithelial populations in a shared embedding mirroring Fig. 4a. The two saved epithelial objects are written only to this run's isolated output directory.

```{r epithelial-enterocyte-reanalysis}
parent_path <- file.path(project_paths$gut_sub_dir, "gut_all_cells_thomas_3p_5p_integrated_filt.rds")
subset_path <- file.path(output_dirs$derived_objects, "epithelial_combined_pre_reclustering.rds")
epi_final_path <- file.path(output_dirs$derived_objects, "epithelial_enterocyte_combined_res02_annotated.rds")

gut_parent <- readRDS(parent_path)
# Retain metadata-only data for downstream metadata export; this avoids reloading the 65-GB parent for the CSV.
md_original <- gut_parent[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("seurat_cell_id")
epi_combined <- subset(gut_parent, subset = annotations_main == "Epithelial cells")
rm(gut_parent); invisible(gc())

if (anyDuplicated(updated_annotations$barcode)) stop("Duplicate barcodes in updated_annotations.")
epi_updated_meta <- updated_annotations |>
  filter(annotations_main == "Epithelial cells", barcode %in% colnames(epi_combined)) |>
  select(barcode, annotations_fine)
epi_idx <- match(colnames(epi_combined), epi_updated_meta$barcode)
if (anyNA(epi_idx) || nrow(epi_updated_meta) != ncol(epi_combined)) {
  stop("Epithelial annotation/barcode matching failed.")
}
epi_combined$annotations_plot <- as.character(epi_updated_meta$annotations_fine[epi_idx])
if (anyNA(epi_combined$annotations_plot)) stop("Some epithelial cells have missing annotations.")

# Save the subsetted pre-reintegration object to the current run directory.
saveRDS(epi_combined, subset_path, compress = FALSE)
epi_by_source <- SplitObject(epi_combined, split.by = "source")
rm(epi_combined, epi_updated_meta, epi_idx); invisible(gc())

epi_by_source <- lapply(epi_by_source, function(x) {
  DefaultAssay(x) <- "RNA"
  x <- NormalizeData(x, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
  FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 1200, verbose = FALSE)
})

epi_integrated <- STACAS::Run.STACAS(epi_by_source, dims = 1:20)
rm(epi_by_source); invisible(gc())
epi_integrated <- RunUMAP(epi_integrated, dims = 1:20, seed.use = 42)
epi_integrated <- FindNeighbors(epi_integrated, dims = 1:20)
epi_integrated <- FindClusters(epi_integrated, resolution = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8), random.seed = 0)

# Marker discovery supports the manual annotation map. Results remain in memory only.
DefaultAssay(epi_integrated) <- "RNA"
Idents(epi_integrated) <- "integrated_snn_res.0.2"
epi_combined_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = epi_integrated, assay = "RNA", only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "wilcox", verbose = FALSE
)

res02_final_labels <- c(
  "0" = "Absorptive enterocytes 1",
  "1" = "Epithelial progenitors",
  "2" = "Stem-like progenitors",
  "3" = "Absorptive enterocytes 2",
  "4" = "Goblet cells",
  "5" = "Paneth cells",
  "6" = "Inflammatory Enterocytes",
  "7" = "M-cell-like progenitors",
  "8" = "Enteroendocrine cells",
  "9" = "Tuft cells",
  "10" = "Epithelial BEST4+"
)
cluster_ids <- as.character(epi_integrated$integrated_snn_res.0.2)
if (!setequal(unique(cluster_ids), names(res02_final_labels))) {
  stop("Resolution-0.2 cluster IDs differ from the established manual annotation map.")
}
epi_integrated$annotations_final_draft <- unname(res02_final_labels[cluster_ids])
if (anyNA(epi_integrated$annotations_final_draft)) stop("Unannotated epithelial clusters remain.")

epi_annotation_metadata <- tibble(
  barcode = colnames(epi_integrated),
  annotations_fine_updated = dplyr::recode(
    as.character(epi_integrated$annotations_final_draft),
    "Inflammatory Enterocytes" = "Inflammatory enterocytes"
  )
)
saveRDS(epi_integrated, epi_final_path, compress = FALSE)
cat("Subsetted epithelial object:", subset_path, "\n")
cat("Final epithelial object:", epi_final_path, "\n")
cat("Combined epithelial cells:", ncol(epi_integrated), "\n")
print(sort(table(epi_integrated$annotations_final_draft), decreasing = TRUE))
rm(epi_integrated, cluster_ids); invisible(gc())
```

## Marker-gene dotplots

```{r export-marker-dotplots}
# ---- Standardised marker-plot export calibration ----

# Master T-cell marker export dimensions (mm)
marker_reference_width_mm  <- 184
marker_reference_height_mm <- 60

# Consistent space around the matrix for labels and legends (mm)
marker_export_margins <- list(
  left   = 36,
  right  = 28,
  top    = 8,
  bottom = 28
)

# Count actual genes and populations in a marker plot.
# Do not use nrow(plot$data): that counts gene-population combinations.
get_marker_grid_counts <- function(plot) {
  required <- c("features.plot", "id")

  if (!all(required %in% names(plot$data))) {
    stop("Plot data must contain 'features.plot' and 'id'.")
  }

  counts <- c(
    n_genes = length(unique(as.character(plot$data$features.plot))),
    n_populations = length(unique(as.character(plot$data$id)))
  )

  if (any(!is.finite(counts)) || any(counts < 1)) {
    stop("Could not determine valid marker-grid dimensions.")
  }

  counts
}

# Measure the actual central plotting panel at specified device dimensions.
measure_dot_panel_mm <- function(plot, width_mm, height_mm) {
  tmp_svg <- tempfile(fileext = ".svg")

  svglite::svglite(
    file = tmp_svg,
    width = width_mm / 25.4,
    height = height_mm / 25.4
  )

  on.exit({
    grDevices::dev.off()
    unlink(tmp_svg)
  }, add = TRUE)

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(ggplot2::ggplotGrob(plot))
  grid::grid.force()

  viewport_names <- grid::grid.ls(
    viewports = TRUE,
    grobs = FALSE,
    print = FALSE
  )$name

  panel_name <- grep("^panel\\.", viewport_names, value = TRUE)[1]

  if (is.na(panel_name)) {
    stop("Could not find the central marker-plot viewport.")
  }

  grid::seekViewport(panel_name)

  result <- c(
    panel_width_mm = grid::convertWidth(
      grid::unit(1, "npc"), "mm", valueOnly = TRUE
    ),
    panel_height_mm = grid::convertHeight(
      grid::unit(1, "npc"), "mm", valueOnly = TRUE
    )
  )

  if (any(!is.finite(result)) || any(result <= 0)) {
    stop("Panel measurement returned invalid dimensions.")
  }

  result
}

# The accepted T-cell reference export
t_reference_size <- c(width = marker_reference_width_mm, height = marker_reference_height_mm)

t_reference_grid <- get_marker_grid_counts(plot_t_markers)

t_reference_panel <- measure_dot_panel_mm(
  plot_t_markers,
  t_reference_size["width"],
  t_reference_size["height"]
)

# Target spacing, measured from the real T-cell matrix
marker_spacing_x_mm <- unname(
  t_reference_panel["panel_width_mm"] / t_reference_grid["n_genes"]
)

marker_spacing_y_mm <- unname(
  t_reference_panel["panel_height_mm"] / t_reference_grid["n_populations"]
)

print(list(
  reference_grid = t_reference_grid,
  reference_panel_mm = t_reference_panel,
  target_spacing_x_mm = marker_spacing_x_mm,
  target_spacing_y_mm = marker_spacing_y_mm
))

# Define reusable calibration and export function
calibrate_and_export_marker <- function(
    plot,
    name,
    output_dir,
    max_iter = 8,
    tolerance_mm = 0.05
) {
  counts <- get_marker_grid_counts(plot)

  target_panel_width_mm <-
    marker_spacing_x_mm * unname(counts["n_genes"])

  target_panel_height_mm <-
    marker_spacing_y_mm * unname(counts["n_populations"])

  # Initial canvas: desired matrix plus shared outer margins
  width_mm <- target_panel_width_mm +
    marker_export_margins$left +
    marker_export_margins$right

  height_mm <- target_panel_height_mm +
    marker_export_margins$top +
    marker_export_margins$bottom

  # Iteratively correct width from the measured rendered panel.
  # With the square-cell aspect ratio in the marker helper,
  # the panel height follows the width correction.
  for (i in seq_len(max_iter)) {
    measured <- measure_dot_panel_mm(plot, width_mm, height_mm)

    width_delta <- target_panel_width_mm -
      unname(measured["panel_width_mm"])

    if (abs(width_delta) < tolerance_mm) break

    width_mm <- width_mm + width_delta

    if (!is.finite(width_mm) || width_mm <= 0) {
      stop("Invalid calibrated width for ", name)
    }
  }

  # Final measurement at the calibrated canvas dimensions
  measured <- measure_dot_panel_mm(plot, width_mm, height_mm)

  target_height_error_mm <-
    unname(measured["panel_height_mm"]) - target_panel_height_mm

  # Export with calibrated dimensions
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(name, "_markers.svg"))

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = plot,
    width = width_mm,
    height = height_mm,
    units = "mm",
    device = svglite::svglite,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(
    lineage = name,
    n_genes = unname(counts["n_genes"]),
    n_populations = unname(counts["n_populations"]),
    target_panel_width_mm = target_panel_width_mm,
    measured_panel_width_mm = unname(measured["panel_width_mm"]),
    target_panel_height_mm = target_panel_height_mm,
    measured_panel_height_mm = unname(measured["panel_height_mm"]),
    height_error_mm = target_height_error_mm,
    export_width_mm = width_mm,
    export_height_mm = height_mm,
    file = output_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Export all non-T marker panels with dimensions calibrated to the T-cell reference.
marker_output_dir <- output_dirs$markers
marker_plots <- list(
  T_cells = plot_t_markers,
  B_cells = plot_b_markers,
  Endothelial = plot_endo_markers,
  Myeloid = plot_myeloid_markers,
  Stromal = plot_stromal_markers,
  Epithelial = plot_epi_markers,
  Small_lineages = plot_small_lineage_markers
)
other_marker_plots <- marker_plots[names(marker_plots) != "T_cells"]
marker_export_manifest <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(other_marker_plots), function(nm) {
    calibrate_and_export_marker(
      plot = other_marker_plots[[nm]], name = nm, output_dir = marker_output_dir
    )
  })
)
write.csv(
  marker_export_manifest,
  file.path(marker_output_dir, "marker_export_manifest.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
print(marker_export_manifest[, c(
  "lineage", "n_genes", "n_populations", "measured_panel_width_mm",
  "measured_panel_height_mm", "height_error_mm", "export_width_mm", "export_height_mm"
)], row.names = FALSE)

# Re-export t markers to fit with others

# Match the established marker-panel grid spacing from the batch report
marker_spacing_x_mm <- 2.0013
marker_spacing_y_mm <- 2.0013

# T-cell marker plot grid counts
t_grid <- get_marker_grid_counts(plot_t_markers)

# Target central matrix dimensions
t_target_panel_width_mm <-
  marker_spacing_x_mm * (t_grid["n_genes"] - 1)

t_target_panel_height_mm <-
  marker_spacing_y_mm * (t_grid["n_populations"] - 1)

# Measure current T-cell matrix at its previous master dimensions
t_panel <- measure_dot_panel_mm(
  plot_t_markers,
  184,
  60
)

# Adjust the canvas to match the other panels' matrix spacing
t_width_final_mm <-
  184 +
  t_target_panel_width_mm -
  unname(t_panel["panel_width_mm"])

t_height_final_mm <-
  60 +
  t_target_panel_height_mm -
  unname(t_panel["panel_height_mm"])

print(c(
  genes = t_grid["n_genes"],
  populations = t_grid["n_populations"],
  target_panel_width_mm = t_target_panel_width_mm,
  measured_panel_width_mm = t_panel["panel_width_mm"],
  target_panel_height_mm = t_target_panel_height_mm,
  measured_panel_height_mm = t_panel["panel_height_mm"],
  export_width_mm = t_width_final_mm,
  export_height_mm = t_height_final_mm
))

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(marker_output_dir, "T_cells_markers.svg"),
  plot = plot_t_markers,
  width = as.numeric(t_width_final_mm),
  height = as.numeric(t_height_final_mm),
  units = "mm",
  device = svglite::svglite,
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```

# 5. Final updated metadata and Supplementary Table 2

The original all-cell metadata are retained in the Seurat object. Updated annotations are created in new columns, based on the agreed simultaneous fine-label mappings and one-to-one fine-to-coarse hierarchy. The filtered metadata and Supplementary Table 2 are written to this run's isolated output directory.

```{r final-metadata-and-supplementary-table}
# Fine-label renames are applied simultaneously to original labels.
fine_rename_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~old_label, ~new_label,

  # Enterocyte populations
  "Transitional Enterocytes", "Absorptive enterocytes",
  "Homeostatic Enterocytes", "Absorptive enterocytes",
  "Inflammatory Enterocytes", "Inflammatory enterocytes",

  # Myeloid populations
  "Homeostatic monocytes", "Inflammatory Mo-derived MQ",
  "Activated chemokine-producing monocytes", "Activated monocytes",
  "Inflammatory Fibroblasts LP", "Inflammatory fibroblasts",
  "migDC", "Early migDC",
  "Inflammatory migDC", "Late migDC",

  # T cells
  "CD4 Tcm", "CD4 Tcm and Tfh",
  "CD8 Tcm", "Tgd",
  "CD8 Tmk", "CD8 Tex",
  "CD8 MAIT", "MAIT cells",
  "Proliferating", "CD4 Naive",

  # Stromal populations
  "Homaostatic Fibroblasts" = "Lamina propria fibroblasts S1",
    "Epithelial-associated Fibroblasts" = "Epithelial-associated fibroblasts S2",
    "Stromal organizer cells" = "Submucosal and FRC-like fibroblasts S3+S4",
    "Homaostatic pericytes" = "Contractile pericytes",
    "Inflammatory pericytes" = "Angiogenic pericytes"
)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(fine_rename_map$old_label))

metadata_updated <- md_original |>
  transmute(
    barcode = as.character(seurat_cell_id),
    source = as.character(source),
    annotations_main_updated = as.character(annotations_main),
    fine_key = as.character(annotations_fine)
  ) |>
  left_join(fine_rename_map, by = c("fine_key" = "old_label")) |>
  mutate(annotations_fine_updated = coalesce(new_label, fine_key)) |>
  select(barcode, source, annotations_main_updated, annotations_fine_updated)

# The combined epithelial object is authoritative for epithelial fine labels.
epi_idx <- match(epi_annotation_metadata$barcode, metadata_updated$barcode)
if (anyNA(epi_idx) || length(epi_idx) != nrow(epi_annotation_metadata)) {
  stop("Could not match all authoritative epithelial annotations to the full metadata.")
}
metadata_updated$annotations_main_updated[epi_idx] <- "Epithelial cells"
metadata_updated$annotations_fine_updated[epi_idx] <- epi_annotation_metadata$annotations_fine_updated

# Exactly one coarse annotation per updated fine label.
fine_to_coarse <- tibble::tribble(
  ~annotations_fine_updated, ~annotations_coarse_updated,

  # T cells
  "CD4 CTL", "CD4+ T cells",
  "CD4 Naive", "CD4+ T cells",
  "CD4 Tcm and Tfh", "CD4+ T cells",
  "CD4 Th17", "CD4+ T cells",
  "CD4 Treg", "CD4+ T cells",
  "CD8 Memory", "CD8+ T cells",
  "CD8 Naive", "CD8+ T cells",
  "CD8 Tex", "CD8+ T cells",
  "MAIT cells", "CD8+ T cells",
  "Tgd", "Tgd",
  "NK cells", "NK cells",
  "ILC", "ILC",

  # B cells
  "CD21low Memory", "Memory B cells",
  "Early plasmablasts", "B cells",
  "GC-like", "GC-like B cells",
  "Memory", "Memory B cells",
  "Memory Early activated", "Memory B cells",
  "Naive", "Naive B cells",
  "Naive IFN", "Naive B cells",

  # Epithelial populations
  "Epithelial progenitors", "Epithelial",
  "Stem-like progenitors", "Epithelial",
  "M-cell-like progenitors", "Epithelial",
  "Epithelial BEST4+", "Epithelial",
  "Absorptive enterocytes 1", "Enterocytes",
  "Absorptive enterocytes 2", "Enterocytes",
  "Inflammatory enterocytes", "Enterocytes",
  "Goblet cells", "Goblet cells",
  "Paneth cells", "Paneth cells",
  "Enteroendocrine cells", "Enteroendocrine cells",
  "Tuft cells", "Tuft cells",

  # Endothelial populations
  "Arterial endothelia", "Blood endothelia",
  "Capillary endothelia", "Blood endothelia",
  "Venous endothelia", "Blood endothelia",
  "HEV-like venous endothelia", "Blood endothelia",
  "Lymphatic endothelia", "Lymphatic endothelia",
  "Pericyte-like endothelia", "Pericyte-like endothelia",
  "Proliferating endothelia", "Proliferating endothelia",

  # Myeloid populations
  "Activated monocytes", "Monocytes",
  "Inflammatory monocytes", "Monocytes",
  "Inflammatory Mo-derived MQ", "Macrophages",
  "Inflammatory MQ", "Macrophages",
  "IFN-activated MQ", "Macrophages",
  "Post-inflammatory MQ", "Macrophages",
  "cDC1", "Dendritic cells",
  "cDC2", "Dendritic cells",
  "Early migDC", "Dendritic cells",
  "Late migDC", "Dendritic cells",
  "pDC", "Dendritic cells",
  "Proliferating myeloid", "Proliferating myeloid",

  # Stromal populations
  "Homeostatic fibroblasts", "Fibroblasts",
  "Epithelial-associated fibroblasts", "Fibroblasts",
  "Inflammatory fibroblasts", "Fibroblasts",
  "Stromal organizer cells", "Fibroblasts",
  "Myofibroblasts", "Fibroblasts",
  "Homeostatic pericytes", "Pericytes",
  "Inflammatory pericytes", "Pericytes",
  "Glia", "Glia",

  # Other lineages
  "Mast cells", "Mast cells",
  "PC IgA", "PC IgA",
  "PC IgG", "PC IgG",
  "Proliferating B cells", "Proliferating B cells",
  "Proliferating T cells", "Proliferating T cells"
)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(fine_to_coarse$annotations_fine_updated))
unmapped_fine <- setdiff(unique(metadata_updated$annotations_fine_updated), fine_to_coarse$annotations_fine_updated)
if (length(unmapped_fine) > 0) stop("Missing coarse mappings for: ", paste(unmapped_fine, collapse = ", "))

fine_to_main <- metadata_updated |> distinct(annotations_fine_updated, annotations_main_updated)
ambiguous_main <- fine_to_main |> count(annotations_fine_updated, name = "n_main") |> filter(n_main != 1)
if (nrow(ambiguous_main) > 0) stop("At least one fine label maps to multiple main labels.")

metadata_updated <- metadata_updated |>
  left_join(fine_to_coarse, by = "annotations_fine_updated") |>
  select(barcode, source, annotations_main_updated, annotations_coarse_updated, annotations_fine_updated)
stopifnot(nrow(metadata_updated) == nrow(md_original), !anyDuplicated(metadata_updated$barcode), !anyNA(metadata_updated))

# Exclude cluster 8 and 10 barcodes from the ORIGINAL B-cell subset only.
b_input <- readRDS(file.path(project_paths$gut_sub_dir, "gut_sub_2.rds"))
b_cluster_col <- "integrated_snn_res.0.5"
if (!b_cluster_col %in% colnames(b_input[[]])) stop("Original B-cell input lacks ", b_cluster_col)
b_doublet_barcodes <- colnames(b_input)[as.character(b_input[[b_cluster_col, drop = TRUE]]) %in% c("8", "10")]
cells_to_remove <- intersect(b_doublet_barcodes, metadata_updated$barcode)
if (length(b_doublet_barcodes) != 7803L || length(cells_to_remove) != 7803L) {
  stop("Expected 7,803 original cluster-8/10 cells; found ", length(cells_to_remove), " in the full metadata.")
}
rm(b_input)
metadata_final <- metadata_updated |> filter(!barcode %in% cells_to_remove)
stopifnot(nrow(metadata_final) == 1006165L)

# Per-cell metadata CSV: barcode, source, and the three UPDATED annotation fields.
metadata_csv_path <- file.path(output_dirs$tables, "per_cell_annotation_metadata_updated.csv")
write.csv(metadata_final, metadata_csv_path, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

# Marker strings come from the named marker lists defined in the lineage sections.
marker_object_names <- c(
  "t_markers", "b_markers", "endo_markers", "epi_markers", "myeloid_markers",
  "stromal_markers", "small_lineage_markers"
)
available_marker_objects <- marker_object_names[
  vapply(marker_object_names, exists, logical(1), envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
]
marker_map <- purrr::map_dfr(available_marker_objects, function(object_name) {
  marker_list <- get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  tibble(
    annotations_fine_updated = names(marker_list),
    Markers = vapply(marker_list, function(genes) {
      paste(unique(unlist(genes, use.names = FALSE)), collapse = ", ")
    }, character(1))
  )
}) |> distinct(annotations_fine_updated, .keep_all = TRUE)
missing_markers <- setdiff(unique(metadata_final$annotations_fine_updated), marker_map$annotations_fine_updated)
if (length(missing_markers) > 0) stop("Missing marker sets: ", paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", "))

# Supplementary Table 2 source-specific counts.
source_levels <- c("PREDICT 5p", "PREDICT 3p", "Thomas")
annotation_combinations <- metadata_final |>
  distinct(annotations_main_updated, annotations_coarse_updated, annotations_fine_updated)
source_counts <- metadata_final |>
  count(annotations_main_updated, annotations_coarse_updated, annotations_fine_updated, source, name = "n_cells")
supp_table_2 <- tidyr::crossing(annotation_combinations, source = source_levels) |>
  left_join(source_counts, by = c("annotations_main_updated", "annotations_coarse_updated", "annotations_fine_updated", "source")) |>
  mutate(n_cells = coalesce(n_cells, 0L)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = n_cells) |>
  left_join(marker_map, by = "annotations_fine_updated")

main_order <- c("T cells", "B cells", "Endothelial cells", "Epithelial cells", "Myeloid cells", "Stromal cells", "Mast cells", "Plasma cells", "Proliferating cells")
fine_orders <- list(
  "T cells" = t_order, "B cells" = b_order, "Endothelial cells" = endo_order,
  "Epithelial cells" = epi_order, "Myeloid cells" = myeloid_order,
  "Stromal cells" = stromal_order, "Mast cells" = mast_order,
  "Plasma cells" = plasma_order, "Proliferating cells" = proliferating_order
)
supp_table_2 <- supp_table_2 |>
  mutate(
    main_order_key = match(annotations_main_updated, main_order),
    fine_order_key = purrr::map2_int(annotations_main_updated, annotations_fine_updated, function(main, fine) match(fine, fine_orders[[main]]))
  )
missing_order <- supp_table_2 |>
  filter(is.na(main_order_key) | is.na(fine_order_key)) |>
  distinct(annotations_main_updated, annotations_coarse_updated, annotations_fine_updated)
if (nrow(missing_order) > 0) {
  print(missing_order)
  stop("Some populations are missing from the main/fine order vectors.")
}
supp_table_2 <- supp_table_2 |>
  arrange(main_order_key, fine_order_key) |>
  select(annotations_main_updated, annotations_coarse_updated, annotations_fine_updated, Markers, all_of(source_levels))
supp_table_path <- file.path(output_dirs$tables, "Supplementary_Table_2_updated.csv")
write.csv(supp_table_2, supp_table_path, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

# Optional large filtered Seurat export. Off by default to make validation safer.
if (isTRUE(export_filtered_seurat)) {
  target_obj <- readRDS(parent_path)
  gut_all_cells_final <- subset(target_obj, cells = metadata_final$barcode)
  metadata_to_attach <- as.data.frame(metadata_final[, c("annotations_main_updated", "annotations_coarse_updated", "annotations_fine_updated")])
  rownames(metadata_to_attach) <- metadata_final$barcode
  gut_all_cells_final <- SeuratObject::AddMetaData(gut_all_cells_final, metadata = metadata_to_attach)
  seurat_output <- file.path(output_dirs$derived_objects, "gut_all_cells_thomas_3p_5p_integrated_filt_final.rds")
  saveRDS(gut_all_cells_final, seurat_output, compress = FALSE)
  cat("Filtered Seurat RDS:", seurat_output, "\n")
  rm(target_obj, gut_all_cells_final, metadata_to_attach)
  invisible(gc())
}

stopifnot(
  sum(as.matrix(supp_table_2[, source_levels])) == nrow(metadata_final),
  !anyNA(supp_table_2$Markers),
  nrow(supp_table_2) == n_distinct(metadata_final$annotations_fine_updated)
)
cat("\n--- Run summary ---\n")
cat("Cells after B-cell doublet exclusion:", nrow(metadata_final), "\n")
cat("Unique fine populations:", n_distinct(metadata_final$annotations_fine_updated), "\n")
cat("Supplementary Table 2 rows:", nrow(supp_table_2), "\n")
cat("Cell-count total:", sum(as.matrix(supp_table_2[, source_levels])), "\n")
cat("Metadata CSV:", metadata_csv_path, "\n")
cat("Supplementary Table 2:", supp_table_path, "\n")
cat("All outputs are isolated under:", output_root, "\n")

rm(md_original, metadata_updated, metadata_final, epi_annotation_metadata)
invisible(gc())
```
